canonicalAgentConcept.root: One YAML Profile completely defines an Agent. The Profile may declare or reference a Skill that supplies behavioral instructions and is loaded as prompt context.
canonicalAgentConcept.zh: 一个 YAML Profile 完全定义一个 Agent。Profile 可以声明或引用提供行为指令的 Skill，该 Skill 会作为 prompt context 加载。
